player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i tetahi whakataetae o GameOfPureStrategy.
- Kei a koe nga kaari 13 A-K; ka taea te whakamahi mo te wa kotahi.
- I ia raounde, ka whakatauiratia he kaari utu. Whakamahea tetahi kaari anake mai i te tuhituhi i tetahi mea e whai ana i tetahi tohu kōtui pērā i '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kaari teitei toa ai i te utu (tae atu ki te moni i mau mai i mua). He honohono, ka piri mai te utu ki te pūtea mo te raounde whakamuri.
- Toa te utu nui rawa i muri i nga raounde 13.

board.hand: Ko tō ringa e toe ana: {hand}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Me whai tonu te mahi i TĒTĀ KATOA tohu kāri e mau ana.
invalid_move.card_not_held: Kāore i a koe taua kāri.
